native_context: Browser-extension messages and privileged capability gates
taxonomy_note: Planning compatibility lens only. Classify the final observed root cause independently; unsupported mappings stay unassigned.

controls.boundary: Browser-extension messages and privileged capability gates — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Read manifest permissions, content/page bridges, runtime listeners and privileged background handlers. Record sender tab/frame/origin and which contexts can reach the listener.
controls.controlled_verification: From an owned untrusted page, exercise the documented bridge with an inert request for a fixture resource. Trace sender provenance through to the privileged action. Compare the intended extension page and the untrusted page, keeping the resource/action constant.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Broad permissions alone do not show a reachable confused deputy. A content-script message must not be treated as an extension-page message merely because it carries an extension-selected action name.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Authorize action/resource against validated sender context and narrow delegated capabilities. Retest expected extension UI, denied page/frame and the actual browser release/build.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
